display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 重复前导估噪的 DURA 求解
description: 同一共享两阶段 DURA 在两个数据集合法无标签源域分别从零训练。候选以重复前导观测估计频率相关噪声，在数据一致性项中增加频域权重。匹配对照沿用包级标量数据一致性。

notes: Same observed pilot geometry and logic across datasets. LoRa 8×1024 native upchirps. WiSig 25 MS/s early L-STF [80:160), 4×20. Adjacent complex correlations align periods for estimation only. The native waveform coordinate system stays unchanged in recovery.

For each frequency remove the frozen Clean median of between-repeat dispersion from observed between-repeat dispersion, clamp at zero, and smooth using adjacent bins. Weights are proportional to inverse square root of clamped dispersion excess plus stabilizer, interpolated across the native packet FFT bins and normalized to RMS one. Fixed bound before normalization [0.5,2]. Wide noise in source models need not satisfy this estimate. It is an observation-derived proxy.

Augment both observation y and linear action A by the same fixed-per-packet self-adjoint frequency multiplier W, so the adjoint is A*W and the likelihood uses ||W(y-Ax)||^2. The original scalar variance and terminal RMS constraint remain. Control has W=I, with identical source objective, data, stages and optimization. Original physical action A continues to receive the same observation supervision outside the fitted likelihood.

Both phases use 512 disjoint U_s clean packets to fit 10-feature geometry and 512 to set its 99.5% quantile. The 512 geometry records also fit the spectral dispersion reference of the candidate. Two smoke records and all 1,024 calibration records are excluded from each arm fit. Distorted synthetic y and no calibration truths enter forward inference.
